mandatory_minimal._note: Evidence-derived (pin fbe6228777e7). HARD deps that must exist before Blender core links even with every optional WITH_* OFF. Sources: platform_unix.cmake unconditional find_package(REQUIRED); dependency_targets.cmake link targets; blenlib/CMakeLists.txt LIB list. See notes/m1-dep-graph.md.
mandatory_minimal._critical_finding: blenlib PUBLIC-links OpenImageIO::OpenImageIO (dependency_targets.cmake:143) + fmt/zlib/zstd/tbb, so the Imath->OpenEXR->OIIO stack is on the M1 tier-(a) gtest critical path, NOT deferrable to M2.

non_gated_required._where: platform_unix.cmake find_package(REQUIRED) with no WITH_* guard

gated_but_on_for_us.python: WITH_PYTHON option default ON, mandatory for UI
gated_but_on_for_us.tbb: WITH_TBB option default ON (CMakeLists.txt:756); Eigen opts into EIGEN_HAS_TBB

pugixml.notes: OIIO build dep (distinct from Blender WITH_PUGIXML feature in forced_off)

brotli.notes: freetype woff2; platform FATALs without it

tbb.notes: oneTBB over -pthread+SharedArrayBuffer; threading is the risk

freetype.notes: must be brotli-enabled; deferrable past M1 gtest link

opencolorio.notes: deps Imath/yamlcpp/expat/pystring/zlib/minizipng; no py bindings for core; deferrable past M1

python.notes: Pyodide precedent; long pole; needs libffi; deferrable past M1 gtest link

epoxy.notes: GL/EGL loader; no consumer in WebGPU-only build; drop the REQUIRED in platform_web.cmake, do NOT cross-compile

mandatory_minimal._m1_critical_path_correction: M1.6 (2026-08-03): OpenColorIO + its leaves (expat, pystring, yamlcpp, minizipng) are NOT deferrable_past_m1 as build_order states — OIIO 3.x hard-requires OCIO (color_ocio.cpp unconditional), and blenlib PUBLIC-links OIIO, so the whole OCIO subtree is on the tier-(a) gtest critical path. All built + installed. See notes/deps-oiio.md.

forced_off._note: deps disabled in patches/blender_web.cmake per GOAL standing decisions; one-word rationale each

imath.notes: static -pthread; CMake config at lib/wasm/lib/cmake/Imath (verified find_package-ready); emcc link test OK; libImath-3_2.a

eigen.notes: header-only; config at lib/wasm/share/eigen3/cmake; EIGEN_BUILD_BLAS/LAPACK=OFF (install had no built blas .a); TBB patch skipped; emcc compile test <Eigen/Dense> OK

zlib.notes: built from Blender-pinned source into lib/wasm (real libz.a) rather than only the emcc --use-port=zlib port, so downstream find_package(ZLIB) for OpenEXR/OIIO/libpng/minizip resolves against a discoverable static archive+header; -pthread; link+run test OK (zlibVersion 1.3.1)

zstd.notes: build/cmake, static only, programs/tests/multithread OFF, -pthread; link+run test OK (ZSTD_versionNumber 10507)

fmt.notes: FMT_TEST/FMT_DOC OFF, static, -pthread; link+run test OK; installs lib/cmake/fmt config

tbb.notes: oneTBB v2022.3.0 static (BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF) via emcc 6.0.5; -pthread; TBBMALLOC on, PROXY off (would collide with -sMALLOC=mimalloc). parallel_for VERIFIED running under wasm threads in node (14 threads, exact sum, no deadlock). Consumer flags: -pthread -fexceptions -sPROXY_TO_PTHREAD (browser-critical; node ok without) -sPTHREAD_POOL_SIZE. See notes/deps-tbb.md. libtbb.a+libtbbmalloc.a+cmake config in lib/wasm.

libjpeg.notes: libjpeg-turbo, WITH_SIMD=OFF (no wasm asm), static, -pthread, JPEG8; needed CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5; bundled GNUInstallDirs put .a in build tree so archive harvested to prefix/lib. scripts/deps/libjpeg.sh

libpng.notes: static, -pthread, PNG_HARDWARE_OPTIMIZATIONS=OFF; links against lib/wasm zlib 1.3.1. scripts/deps/libpng.sh

epoxy.notes: M1.2: WITH_OPENGL_BACKEND OFF in platform_wasm.cmake; only REQUIRED find lived in platform_unix (bypassed). No GL consumer in WebGPU build; not cross-compiled.

vulkan.notes: M1.2: WITH_VULKAN_BACKEND forced OFF in platform_wasm.cmake; WebGPU backend replaces it. Not built.

shaderc.notes: M1.2: dropped with Vulkan backend; BSL->SPIR-V->WGSL chain re-introduces it via gpu/webgpu in M3. Not built.

libdeflate.notes: OpenEXR 3.4 compression backend (replaces zlib in EXR core). Static, -pthread, GZIP/SHARED/TESTS OFF. Built externally + installed (vendored copy in openexr tarball is EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL, never installed). CMake config lib/cmake/libdeflate (libdeflate::libdeflate_static). scripts/deps/libdeflate.sh

openjph.notes: HTJ2K codec linked PRIVATE by OpenEXRCore. OpenJPH has native EMSCRIPTEN support (auto BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF, TIFF OFF). OJPH_DISABLE_SIMD=ON => generic wasm codepath (no -msimd128), matching -pthread-only stack. Built externally+installed (vendored openexr copy not installed). libopenjph.a + config lib/cmake/openjph (openjph-config.cmake). scripts/deps/openjph.sh

openexr.notes: Static, -pthread (IlmThread pthreads). find_package(Imath CONFIG) resolves from prefix via Imath_DIR. 3.4 core needs libdeflate+openjph -> external via libdeflate_DIR/openjph_DIR (OPENEXR_FORCE_INTERNAL_*=OFF). Tools/examples/python/tests OFF. Libs Iex/IlmThread/OpenEXR/OpenEXRCore/OpenEXRUtil-3_4. emcc link test (Header+ChannelList+ZIP_COMPRESSION) OK, 240K wasm. Config lib/cmake/OpenEXR. scripts/deps/openexr.sh

tiff.notes: libtiff static, -pthread. Explicit ZLIB(libz.a)+JPEG(libjpeg.a) from prefix; lzma/jbig/zstd/webp/lerc OFF; tools/tests/contrib/docs OFF. ZIP via zlib (libdeflate off, matches upstream tiff.cmake). libtiff.a+libtiffxx.a. emcc link test (TIFFGetVersion) OK. Needed by OIIO REQUIRED_DEP. scripts/deps/libtiff.sh

robinmap.notes: tsl::robin_map header-only; OIIO REQUIRED_DEP. CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5. Config at share/cmake/tsl-robin-map (NOT lib/cmake); consumer passes ROBINMAP_INCLUDE_DIR=include for OIIO's FindRobinmap. scripts/deps/robinmap.sh

expat.notes: libexpat static -pthread; OCIO dep. Tools/tests/examples OFF. Config lib/cmake/expat-2.7.5. scripts/deps/expat.sh

pystring.notes: OCIO dep; ships no CMake -> minimal CMakeLists written (Blender-style). libpystring.a + include/pystring.h; no config pkg (OCIO Findpystring uses pystring_ROOT/INCLUDE_DIR/LIBRARY). scripts/deps/pystring.sh

yamlcpp.notes: yaml-cpp static -pthread; OCIO dep. Tests/tools/contrib OFF. Config lib/cmake/yaml-cpp. scripts/deps/yamlcpp.sh

minizipng.notes: minizip-ng static -pthread; OCIO dep. zlib-only (all other compression OFF, matches OCIO/Blender), MZ_COMPAT=ON -> libminizip.a; headers include/minizip-ng/minizip. Consumer passes minizip-ng_INCLUDE_DIR/_LIBRARY (NOT minizip-ng_ROOT: OCIO's Findminizip-ng has a ROOT-defined get_target_property trap). scripts/deps/minizipng.sh

opencolorio.notes: HARD dep of OIIO 3.x (not deferrable — see notes/deps-oiio.md). Static -pthread -fexceptions, OCIO_USE_SIMD/SSE=OFF, apps/python/nuke/java/docs/tests/GPU OFF, INSTALL_EXT_PACKAGES=NONE. External deps: Imath/yaml-cpp/expat/pystring/minizip-ng/zlib via explicit *_DIR + INCLUDE/LIBRARY. libOpenColorIO.a 13MB, config lib/cmake/OpenColorIO. scripts/deps/opencolorio.sh

openimageio.notes: THE long pole — built OK. Static -pthread -fexceptions. Trimmed readers EXR/TIFF/PNG/JPEG only; EMBEDPLUGINS on, no tools/python/tbb/webp/oj/heif/raw/jxl/ocv/qt/freetype; USE_SIMD=0; USE_EXTERNAL_PUGIXML=OFF (bundled). OCIO ON (mandatory in 3.x). No host-tool run step. Source patches: OCIO link guards + libutil __EMSCRIPTEN__ port (strcasecmp_l/isatty/usleep/this_program_path). emcc link test builds ImageSpec+serialize -> wasm OK. libOpenImageIO.a 26MB + libOpenImageIO_Util.a, config lib/cmake/OpenImageIO. Consumer (Blender find_package) must pass the full transitive hint-var set; see notes/deps-oiio.md. scripts/deps/openimageio.sh
